nodes.text: 人工呼吸器 決策指南 Ventilator Decision Aid COALITION FOR COMPASSIONATE CARE OF CALIFORNIA
nodes.why: title union: document type + its translation + owner logo header box #3 (Coalition for Compassionate Care of California). User decision 2026-11-13: when the owner is printed only as a logo, the logo's text joins the L1 union if the layout has a box holding that text (was: 人工呼吸器 決策指南 Ventilator Decision Aid).

nodes.text: 什麽是人工呼吸器？ What is a ventilator?
nodes.why: section: question heading (zh + en translation union) over its answer block

nodes.text: 當病人連上人工呼吸器時會發生什麼情況？如何操作？ What happens when someone is attached to a ventilator? How is it done?
nodes.why: section: question heading + translation, bullet block below

nodes.text: 什麼時候須要人工呼吸器？ When do people need a ventilator?
nodes.why: section: question heading + translation, contains the short/long-term reason blocks

nodes.text: 短期使用人工呼吸器的原因可能包括： Reasons for short-term ventilator use may include:
nodes.why: label heading: own line in heading style with its own bullet block, a subdivision of the 'when needed' section (content beats look)

nodes.text: 長期使用人工呼吸器的原因包括： Reasons for long-term ventilator use may include:
nodes.why: label heading: sibling of short-term reasons, own bullet block

nodes.text: 誰應該使用這份指南？ Who should use this guide?
nodes.why: section: question heading + translation in its own panel

nodes.text: 人工呼吸器可能有何帮助？How might using a ventilator help?
nodes.why: section: question heading (zh + en on one line)

nodes.text: 人工呼吸器可能造成哪些傷害？How might a ventilator cause harm?
人工呼吸器能使病情好转嗎？Does a ventilator help people to get better?
人工呼吸器對哪些病人最有益？Who is most likely to be helped from being on a ventilator?
人工呼吸器對哪些病人較無益？Who is less likely to be helped by using a ventilator?
使用人工呼吸器，會是什麼樣的情況？ What is it like being on a ventilator?
一旦用了人工呼吸器，他們可以停止不用嗎？ Once someone is on a ventilator, can they come off?
如果有人需要長時間使用人工呼吸器，會有什麼情況出現呢？ What happens if someone needs a ventilator for a long time?
對決定不嘗試人工呼吸器的病人，會有什麼情況？ What happens to people who decide NOT to try a ventilator?
人們如何決定是否要試用人工呼吸器？ How do people decide whether or not to try a ventilator?

not_headings.why: list lead-in in bold black body style ending in a colon, introduces the bullet list (run-in label, not the coloured heading style)

considered.why: bold body-style key statement followed by its explanation: text, not the coloured heading style
